records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 28, 2025, 37% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The twelve-month backlog increased in the third quarter of 2025 compared with the third quarter of 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The twelve-month backlog in Military Aircraft increased due to the timing of orders across legacy and new OEM programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin decreased in the third quarter of 2025 compared to the third quarter of 2024, driven by inventory write-downs of $6 million, primarily within Industrial and Military Aircraft.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used by investing activities in the first three quarters of 2025 included $103 million of capital expenditures for investments in organic growth, which was partially offset by $13 million of proceeds from the sales of businesses.
